policy: A skipped integration, security, browser, migration or restore test is a FAILED GATE (AGENTS.md Quality rules; plan.md rule 10; plan.md section 10). An entry in this file is the ONLY way to keep a single skipped test case from failing a build, and it is deliberately expensive to add one.
rules: One entry names exactly one fully-qualified test class and exactly one test case display name. There is no wildcard form; check-no-hidden-skips.ps1 rejects '*' in either field outright.
Every entry carries a reason (>= 10 characters, an actual justification), a ticket, an expiresOn date no more than 30 days out, and an approvedBy human or system.
An entry that matches nothing FAILS as stale. A waiver nobody exercises is how a temporary exception becomes permanent.
An expired entry FAILS even when it would otherwise match.
The waiver suppresses the failure, never the fact. The skipped test still appears in the evidence bundle as a waived skip.
Adding a row here is a reviewable decision. Reviewers should ask why the test is skipped rather than why it is not written.
